rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for cattle, including cows, bulls, oxen, and other bovines.

example.english: The cattle here are very docile.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 di1 ngau4 hou2 gwaai1

rows.note: Use this more formal collective/count noun when referring to cattle as animals in news, official, or agricultural contexts rather than everyday speech.

example.english: The farm transported a batch of cattle to the slaughterhouse today.
example.traditional: 農場今日運送咗一批牛隻去屠房。
example.jyutping: nung4 coeng4 gam1 jat6 wan6 sung3 zo2 jat1 pai1 ngau4 zek3 heoi3 tou4 fong2
